foundations.statement: Original period data, fields, Good/GamS/WSer/IoS/IoW, including all prescribed maps; their universal existence is not asserted by this chapter.

Finite fields, Galois extension of embeddings, finite free bases, determinant and tensor identities, coefficientwise formal-series algebra and inverse-limit completeness. The needed convergence and quotient steps are proved explicitly.
LS2/LS4, WIS actual rings and fixed completeness, IFD actual action and invariant descent, WLD26 original lattice consumer. Each input is rebound in inherited_inputs.json.
Original tied-period data and crystalline-realization input are exactly the hypotheses of the completed WachLattice.main implication.
